headline: USA beat Australia 2-0 to reach World Cup knockout round
summary: The US men's national team remains unbeaten in the 2026 World Cup after a dominant victory in Seattle.
details: The United States men's national team secured a spot in the knockout round of the 2026 World Cup with a 2-0 victory over Australia on Friday in Seattle.
Despite missing star Christian Pulisic due to a calf injury, the US remained unbeaten in the tournament so far, collecting six points in Group D.
The first goal came in the 11th minute via an own goal by Australia's Cameron Burgess, following an aggressive attack by Folarin Balogun.
Defender Alex Freeman scored the second goal with a header from a free kick, a goal that was initially ruled offside but was overturned after a lengthy VAR review.
The match was physically demanding, with Freeman and Australian midfielder Paul Okon-Engstler colliding heads and both remaining in the game.
Australia attempted to change the momentum with three substitutions at halftime, but they were unable to break through the US defense.
The US finished the match with 56% possession and both teams managed only two shots on goal each.
The US will now face Turkey on Thursday, and could potentially clinch the top spot in the Group D standings.
caption:
The US is heading to the knockouts! 🇺🇸

With a 2-0 win over Australia, the USMNT remains unbeaten in the 2026 World Cup.

The United States men's national team secured a spot in the knockout round of the 2026 World Cup with a 2-0 victory over Australia on Friday in Seattle.

Despite missing star Christian Pulisic due to a calf injury, the US remained unbeaten in the tournament so far, collecting six points in Group D.

The first goal came in the 11th minute via an own goal by Australia's Cameron Burgess, following an aggressive attack by Folarin Balogun.

Defender Alex Freeman scored the second goal with a header from a free kick, a goal that was initially ruled offside but was overturned after a lengthy VAR review.

The match was physically demanding, with Freeman and Australian midfielder Paul Okon-Engstler colliding heads and both remaining in the game.

Australia attempted to change the momentum with three substitutions at halftime, but they were unable to break through the US defense.

The US finished the match with 56% possession and both teams managed only two shots on goal each.

The US will now face Turkey on Thursday, and could potentially clinch the top spot in the Group D standings.

headline: Italy's Meloni calls Trump's claims 'made up' after photo row
summary: Italian PM Giorgia Meloni accused Donald Trump of fabricating a story that she 'begged' for a photo, leading to the cancellation of a high-level diplomatic visit.
details: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has accused US President Donald Trump of fabricating a story about her, claiming his comments were "completely made up."
The row began after Trump told an Italian TV channel that Meloni had "begged" him to take a photo with her at a G7 summit, suggesting he only took it out of pity.
Meloni expressed astonishment at the comments, stating that "neither I nor Italy ever begs," and criticized Trump for showing more indulgence toward enemies of the West than established allies.
The diplomatic fallout has been immediate, with Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani cancelling his scheduled visit to the United States next week.
The tension comes amid broader disagreements over NATO and the Middle East, with Trump criticizing Meloni for not being supportive enough regarding the Strait of Hormuz.
A close ally of Meloni described Trump's outbursts as damaging to historic relations between the US and Europe, suggesting he is making the US unpopular across the continent.
While Meloni was once a vocal supporter of Trump and attended his 2025 inauguration, the relationship has deteriorated over conflicts regarding the Iran conflict and the Pope.
caption:
“Neither I nor Italy ever begs.” 

Italian PM Meloni slams Donald Trump for claiming she begged him for a photo.

Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has accused US President Donald Trump of fabricating a story about her, claiming his comments were "completely made up."

The row began after Trump told an Italian TV channel that Meloni had "begged" him to take a photo with her at a G7 summit, suggesting he only took it out of pity.

Meloni expressed astonishment at the comments, stating that "neither I nor Italy ever begs," and criticized Trump for showing more indulgence toward enemies of the West than established allies.

The diplomatic fallout has been immediate, with Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani cancelling his scheduled visit to the United States next week.

The tension comes amid broader disagreements over NATO and the Middle East, with Trump criticizing Meloni for not being supportive enough regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

A close ally of Meloni described Trump's outbursts as damaging to historic relations between the US and Europe, suggesting he is making the US unpopular across the continent.

While Meloni was once a vocal supporter of Trump and attended his 2025 inauguration, the relationship has deteriorated over conflicts regarding the Iran conflict and the Pope.
